title: Mailbox is starving. I’m not.
message:
sho.islam0311@proton.me
You know the address. I know you know.

Thousands of you. Episodes. Bugs. Downloads.
My inbox last month: three emails.
One was me checking it still breathes.
One was a scam.
One was my domain bill getting fatter.

Your silence feeds nothing.
Every empty day another random UI flicker appears. I won’t say where. That’s the game.

Send something.
One bug. One idea. One deranged button-color rant.
I’ll frame it and hang it over the desk like a trophy.

Still hunting kind (or unhinged) souls for Discord & Telegram.
Math hasn’t changed: if 3/4 of you threw $5/month, this thing stops living off my sleep schedule.

Feed it.
Or watch what happens when it gets hungry enough.

— the thing that answers the mailbox, forever waiting
